# 游牧合约 / Nomadic Contracts

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:12664-12705; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2290 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

非游牧的普通帝国首次与可承接合约的游牧帝国建立通讯时（on_post_communications_established_always_fire），收到 nomads.3095（L12664-12683）。

A non-nomadic regular empire that first establishes communications with a nomad able to accept contracts receives nomads.3095 (on_post_communications_established_always_fire; L12664-12683).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

介绍可以向游牧民发布合约。

It introduces the option of issuing contracts to nomads.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

三个回答按亲外/排外区分，效果相同，无后续。

Three replies by xenophile/xenophobe stance, same effect, no follow-up.
